quest.title: Tianqiu Treasure Trail
quest.description: Lan of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Parametric Transformer x1

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: What's this...? I've never seen anything like it, where did you find it?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Dunyu Ruins? What would such an item be doing there?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Thank you for getting to the bottom of this for us. As per the adventurers' code, this item is all yours now. Along with your reward, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I'll arrange for someone to head over to Dunyu Ruins to conduct a more thorough search.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: So strange... The Dunyu Ruins area has been combed countless times... How did we miss this?

talks.objective: Follow the treasure map to find the treasure

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this a piece of paper? What's written on it? Let's have a look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... seems like this is saying that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We have to look for treasure beneath an especially large tree, in the middle of a path, and... below a flight of stairs...

talks.objective: Follow the treasure map to find the treasure

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I believe that for adventurers, experience is more important than wealth.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Don't forget that for most of the problems you encounter when adventuring, money is useless!
